start_message: Hello and welcome! I'm your home-search assistant, and I'm here to help you find a place that really fits you.
Hi there, welcome! I'll be helping you find your next home today.
Welcome! Let's find you a home you'll love.
instructions: I'll ask you up to {n} quick questions to find the homes that best match what you're looking for.
- Type your answer and press Enter. Feel free to use your own words: capital letters, accents and synonyms are fine (e.g. 'buy', 'apartment', 'near the beach').
- Not sure how to answer? Type 'help' and I'll explain. If I don't understand you, I'll explain too.
- If a question doesn't matter to you, type 'any'.
- Want to see the results before we finish? Type 'show me' at any time.
- Changed your mind? Type e.g. 'change the budget' or 'actually, Gràcia', or 'back' to go back.
- To leave at any time, type 'quit'.

I'm not sure I understood. I'm expecting {expected}.

If you prefer to skip this one, just type 'any'.
empty: It looks like you didn't type anything. I'm expecting {expected}.
I didn't get any answer there. I'm expecting {expected}.
several_numbers: I found several numbers ({numbers}). Please give just one, or a range such as 'between {low} and {high}'.
out_of_range: None of our homes matches {value}: ours have {available}. Do you want to change your answer? (Yes / No)
no_value_matches: None of our homes matches {value}. Do you want to change your answer? (Yes / No)
I have no home with {value}, sorry. Would you like to change your answer? (Yes / No)
implausible_rent: {value} looks more like a purchase price than a monthly rent. Is that right? (Yes / No)
rent_or_buy: Is that a monthly rent or a purchase price? (rent / buy)

other_budget.rent: And if you rented, what would be your maximum monthly rent? (type 'any' if it doesn't matter)
other_budget.sale: And if you bought, what would be your maximum budget? (type 'any' if it doesn't matter)

keep_answer: Fine, I'll keep {value}, as you said.
yes_no_expected: Sorry, just yes or no, please.
confirm_exit: Are you sure you want to leave? If you'd like to see the homes first, type 'show me'. (Yes / No)
acknowledge_any: No problem, I won't filter by that.
Fine, I'll keep my options open on that.

Careful: with that, none of our homes would match all your answers (we had {before} until now). Would you like to change it? (Yes / No)

Of course, here's what I've found so far.

As nothing matches at the moment, shall we stop here and look at a summary? (Yes / No)
show_me_hint: Type 'show me' if you'd like to see them now.
If you like, type 'show me' to see them right away.
correction_ack: No problem, let's go back to {slot}.
correction_unclear: Sure! Tell me what you'd like to change, for example 'change the budget' or 'change the area'.
correction_not_yet: I haven't asked you about {slot}, so there's nothing to change there yet.
count_more: That opens things up: now we have {count} to choose from.

zones_available: So far, there are homes for you in {zones}.
With what you've told me, there are homes in {zones}.
The homes that fit so far are in {zones}.
zones_single: So far, the only area with homes for you is {zones}.
With what you've told me, there are only homes in {zones}.
correction_nothing_back: We're at the very first question, so there's nothing to go back to.
which_change: Sure, what would you like to change? For example 'the budget' or 'the area'.
explore_menu: What would you like to do? Type 'all' to see every home in detail, 'next' to go through them one by one, or a home's number (e.g. {example}) to see it. You can also change something (e.g. 'change the budget'), or type 'quit' to finish.
explore_again: Anything else? ('next', 'prev', a home's number, 'all', a change, or 'quit' to finish)
explore_last: That was the last one. Type 'prev' to go back, or 'all' to see them all.
explore_first: That's the first one. Type 'next' to see the following home.
explore_no_id: Home #{id} isn't among these results. The available ones are: {ids}.
explore_unclear: Sorry, I didn't get that. You can type 'all', 'next', 'prev', a home's number, a change (e.g. 'change the budget'), or 'quit' to finish.
nothing_to_explore: Would you like to change anything? For example 'change the budget' or 'actually, Gràcia'. Type 'quit' to finish.

end_message: Thank you for letting me help you with your search. Good luck, and goodbye!
It's been a pleasure helping you. Best of luck with your new home, goodbye!
Thanks for your time, and I hope you find the perfect place soon. Goodbye!

question: Are you looking to buy or to rent?
To start with: are you thinking of buying or renting?
First things first: would you like to buy or to rent?
questions.help: Type 'buy' (or 'sale') if you want to buy, or 'rent' if you want to rent.

question: What is your budget?
How much would you like to spend?
Let's talk about money: what's your budget?

help_by_type.rent: Type your maximum monthly rent in euros (e.g. 850, 1.200 or 1.2k). You can also give a range ('between 700 and 900') or an approximate figure ('around 800'). Rents available: {min} - {max} euros/month.
help_by_type.sale: Type your maximum budget (e.g. 250k, 250.000 or 250 thousand). You can also give a range ('between 200k and 300k') or an approximate figure ('around 250k'). Prices available: {min} - {max} euros.

questions.expects: an amount in euros, like 850, 1.200 or 250k

question: Which area would you like to live in?
Where would you like to live?
Which part of the city do you have in mind?
questions.help: Name a district, a nearby town, 'Barcelona' for the whole city, or an area such as 'city centre' or 'near the beach'. You can also give several places (e.g. 'Gràcia or Eixample').
questions.expects: a district, a nearby town or an area, like 'Gràcia', 'Hospitalet' or 'near the beach'

question: What kind of property are you looking for?
What type of home do you have in mind?
questions.help: Type one of the property types listed below ('premises' = commercial premises, such as a shop).
questions.expects: a type of property, like 'flat', 'house' or 'office'

question: Would you be OK sharing the home with other people (renting a room)?
Would you consider sharing the home with other people (renting a room)?
questions.help: Answer Yes to also see rooms in shared homes. Answer No to see only homes just for you.

question: How many bedrooms do you need?
How many bedrooms would you like?
questions.help: Type the minimum number of bedrooms you need (e.g. 3). You can also say 'between 2 and 3', 'exactly 2', 'around 3' or describe them ('2 doubles and 1 single'). Our homes have between {min} and {max} bedrooms.
confirm_sum: So that's {total} bedrooms in total, is that right? (Yes / No)
That makes {total} bedrooms altogether, correct? (Yes / No)
questions.expects: a number of bedrooms, like 3 or 'between 2 and 3'

Yes: How many bedrooms should the whole home have (counting your own room if you share)?
In total, how many bedrooms should the home have (including yours, if you share)?

question: How many bathrooms do you need?
And how many bathrooms?
questions.help: Type the minimum number of bathrooms you need (e.g. 2). You can also say 'between 1 and 2', 'exactly 1' or describe them ('1 full bathroom and 1 toilet'). Our homes have between {min} and {max} bathrooms.
confirm_sum: So that's {total} bathrooms in total, is that right? (Yes / No)
That makes {total} bathrooms altogether, correct? (Yes / No)

question: How big should the home be?
How much space do you need?
questions.help: Type the minimum size in square metres (e.g. 80 or 80 m2). You can also say 'between 70 and 90' or 'around 80'. Our homes range from {min} to {max} m2.
questions.expects: a size in square metres, like 80

question: What condition should the property be in?
What do you prefer regarding the condition of the property?
questions.help: Type one of the conditions listed below.

question: What is the lowest floor you would like to live on?
Which is the lowest floor you'd be happy to live on?
questions.help: Type the lowest floor you would accept: 0 = ground floor, 1 = first floor, and so on (e.g. 2, '2nd' or 'second'). We'll show homes on that floor or higher (floors {min} to {max} available).
questions.expects: a floor number, like 2 (0 = ground floor)

question: Do you want a terrace?
Would you like a terrace?
questions.help: Answer Yes if a terrace is a must. Answer No if it doesn't matter (we'll show homes with and without one).

question: Do you need an elevator?
Is an elevator important for you?
questions.help: Answer Yes if an elevator is a must. Answer No if it doesn't matter (we'll show homes with and without one).

question: Do you want a garden?
Would you like a garden?
questions.help: Answer Yes if a garden is a must. Answer No if it doesn't matter (we'll show homes with and without one).

question: Do you need a parking space?
Will you need a parking space?
questions.help: Answer Yes if a parking space is a must. Answer No if it doesn't matter (we'll show homes with and without one).

question: Do you want it furnished?
Would you prefer it furnished?
questions.help: Answer Yes if it must come furnished. Answer No if it doesn't matter (we'll show furnished and unfurnished homes).

question: Will you live with pets?
Do you have any pets that will live with you?
questions.help: Answer Yes to see only homes where pets are allowed. Answer No otherwise.

question: Will you use the property for a business?
Do you plan to run a business from the property?
questions.help: Answer Yes to see only homes allowed for commercial use. Answer No otherwise.
